text:
Aisha (marketing): quick heads up — planning the release announce for Redwood Optimize v2 next Tue 9am PT. need final changelog + docs links + webinar slot confirmed. can eng confirm rollout window?
Tom (engineering): we can do a staged rollout. proposed canary Tue 6am PT, ramp to 10% at 7am, full at 9:30am if metrics look good. is that compatible with marketing timing?
Aisha (marketing): sounds ok, want the public announce at 9am. if canary goes well we’ll flip messaging to ‘live’ in the blog post at 9:15 and start the webinar CTA at 9:30.
Jordan (docs): docs PR is open: https://docs.redwood.ai/pr/482 — changelog snippet is in the top section. will push updates by EOD today.
Riley (devex): webinar confirmed with Heather at 10am PT slot for demo + q&a. landing page draft: https://redwood.ai/webinar/optimize-v2-preview — need a short bullet list of benchmark highlights for the hero.
Tom (engineering): benchmark bullets (draft):
```
- 2.3x throughput improvement on long-sequence workloads vs v1
- 20% lower per-token cost via dynamic batching and prefix cache
- Maintains <120ms tail latency at 95th pct for 32k context tests
```
Aisha (marketing): perfect. can we make the first bullet more user-facing? e.g., "handles long conversations 2x faster"
Tom (engineering): updated: "handles long conversations ~2x faster for multi-turn apps"
Jordan (docs): pulling that into the changelog now. also adding migration notes for caching config.
InfraBot: Deploy window reserved: staging canary @ 2026-03-31T06:00:00Z, prod rollout start @ 2026-03-31T09:00:00Z. Automated rollback policy: 10% error rate in 5m triggers rollback.
Ops Oncall: noted. I'll monitor error rates and perf dashboards during the 6–10am window. ping me @ops if we need hot rollback.
Aisha (marketing): copy — marketing will send embargoed blog draft and social copy to the list by EOD for approvals. final ask: please post the final changelog URL in this thread once merged so we can link from the announce. :thumbsup:
Tom (engineering): will post the merge link here after merge.
Jordan (docs): merged — changelog URL: https://docs.redwood.ai/changelog/optimize-v2 — added example config and quickstart snippet.
Aisha (marketing): beautiful. final checklist for release day:
- engineering: monitor canary + post merge link (you)
- docs: confirm redirect and sample configs (you)
- devex: webinar landing + signup (you)
- marketing: blog + social at 9am, webinar CTA at 9:30 (me)
All: any blockers?
Tom (engineering): nothing blocking from infra. we do ask marketing to avoid heavy traffic spikes in the first 10 mins — we'll have autoscaling but want to verify warm pools before spikes.
Aisha (marketing): will gate major mail blasts until 9:15. small organic posts earlier ok.
Riley (devex): will share the demo script + invite list by EOD.
Aisha (marketing): thanks everyone — I’ll consolidate and share the final day-of runbook in this thread tomorrow morning. :rocket:
